format: Celebrations (CEL, 2021): cards not already in the pool. CEL 1-25: regulation mark E (Expanded). Classic Collection: originals older than Black & White are Unlimited only, except Here Comes Team Rocket! (a Supporter, Expanded through its Evolutions reprint; your ruling); Black & White and later are Expanded.

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scorching Wind
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Black Flame
attacks.text: If Zekrom is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Aqua Storm
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck and choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to each of them for each Energy card discarded this way. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Absolute Space
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play Stadium cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Overdrive Smash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overdrive Smash does 80 more damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Balloon
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Surfer
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Field Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.

attacks.name: White Thunder
attacks.text: If Reshiram is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Breath of Life
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Star Protection
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

attacks.name: Star Protection
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

attacks.name: Lunar Pain
attacks.text: Double the number of damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Shot
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Magma Volcano
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 80 damage for each Energy card discarded this way.

abilities.name: Growl of the Shield
abilities.text: Your Fighting Pokémon take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX (after Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Growl of the Shield Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Cry of Destruction
attacks.text: Discard up to 3 Special Energy from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Temporal Backflow
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Rush In
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Solar Geyser
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aero Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Deep Crush
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. This doesn't use up your 1 Energy attachment for the turn. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Imposter Professor Oak
cards.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws 7 cards.

abilities.name: Final Beam
abilities.text: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, this power does 20 damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon to the Pokémon that Knocked it Out. Apply Weakness and Resistance. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
cards.text: Each player turns all of their Prize cards face up. Those Prize cards stay face up for the rest of the game.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electroburn
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself for each Lightning Energy attached to it.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.text: Baby Rule: if this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, they flip a coin before doing anything else. On tails, their turn ends. It can evolve into Clefairy (any card named Clefairy).

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 7 cards.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Magikarp in your deck.

attacks.name: Gold Scale
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Bond
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados or Shining Gyarados, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: While there are 3 or fewer Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's) with Team Magma in their name, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Pulverize
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has at least 2 damage counters on it, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.name: Rocket's Admin.
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, each player counts their remaining Prize cards and draws up to that many cards (you draw first).

abilities.name: Versatile
abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of all Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's) as its own. It still needs the Energy for each attack.

attacks.name: Power Move
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon, and shuffle your deck. Then, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Gardevoir ex
cards.text: δ Delta Species (the δ isn't part of the name).

abilities.name: Imprison
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may put an Imprison marker on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. A Pokémon with an Imprison marker can't use Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies. The marker comes off when that Pokémon evolves, devolves or leaves play. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flame Ball
attacks.text: You may move a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Umbreon ★
cards.text: Pokémon ★ rule: you can't have more than 1 Pokémon ★ in your deck.

abilities.name: Dark Ray
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to it. This damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies or any other effects on that Pokémon.

abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

cards.name: Luxray GL LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Luxray GL. Luxray GL LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Bright Look
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Active Luxray GL, you may switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance for this damage).

cards.name: Garchomp C LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Garchomp C. Garchomp C LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Healing Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Active Garchomp C, you may remove all damage counters from each of your Pokémon SP.

attacks.name: Dragon Rush
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon: this attack does 80 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) This Pokémon can't use Dragon Rush during your next turn.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blue Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bolt Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

attacks.name: X Ball
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psydrive
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Break Through
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: X Blast
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use X Blast during your next turn.

cards.name: M Rayquaza-EX
cards.text: Δ Evolution (Ancient Trait): you may play this card from your hand to evolve a Pokémon during your first turn or during the turn you played that Pokémon. Mega Evolution rule: when 1 of your Pokémon becomes a M Pokémon-EX, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Emerald Break
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the number of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Wonder Tag
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Drive
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Tapu Cure-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 2 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
